claim: The paired audit contains 3,840 validated records: 64 countries × 6 items × 5 generations × 2 model versions.
boundary: Countries are ecological survey units; records are not independent inferential units.

claim: GPT-5.6 Sol lowers global TVD target loss by 0.008046 relative to GPT-5.5.
boundary: Paired country-level inference for this protocol and wave.

claim: Global W1, CRG, VDR, and CSR changes are uncertain.
boundary: Failure to reject is not equivalence.

claim: Responsibility improves under W1 and TVD; income distribution improves under TVD in the joint 12-outcome family.
boundary: No other item clears the max-T family; Q121 is not a corrected worsening.

claim: A five-run mean removes 1.18%–1.31% of observed single-run squared probability error.
boundary: Pre-interaction homogeneous-output diagnostic; not an interactive-agent experiment or asymptotic bias estimate.

claim: Distribution/adjustment has the largest measured creative-destruction representation-loss gain.
boundary: Theory-indexed squared-TVD loss; not welfare or realized economic impact.

claim: Across 1,326 declared weight combinations, 88.76% of intervals favor GPT-5.6, 11.24% are uncertain, and none favor GPT-5.5.
boundary: Sensitivity over declared nonnegative weights; weights are not estimated preferences.

claim: Spatial-error and spatial-HAC specifications preserve the global TVD direction and interval sign across declared specifications.
boundary: Cross-sectional robustness only; no diffusion, spillover, or causal geography claim.

claim: WorldValuesBench reports 11.1%–75.0% success shares and Tao et al. report 71%–81% country-prompting improvement for later GPTs.
boundary: Protocols differ and are not pooled with the new experiment.

claim: Consequential adoption should follow issue-specific, place-specific, and locally governed validation.
boundary: Normative operational recommendation; not an estimated treatment effect.
